headword: {食欲不振|しょくよくふしん}

definitions.explanation: A condition where one has little or no desire to eat. Commonly used in medical and health contexts. Composed of {食欲|しょくよく} (appetite) + {不振|ふしん} (poor performance, slump).

examples.japanese: {食欲不振|しょくよくふしん}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: My loss of appetite has been continuing.

examples.japanese: ストレスが{原因|げんいん}で{食欲不振|しょくよくふしん}になった。
examples.english: I lost my appetite due to stress.

examples.japanese: {食欲不振|しょくよくふしん}や{不眠|ふみん}などの{症状|しょうじょう}が{出|で}たら、{早|はや}めに{医師|いし}に{相談|そうだん}してください。
examples.english: If you experience symptoms such as loss of appetite or insomnia, please consult a doctor promptly.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal medical or health term. Often listed alongside other symptoms when describing illness or side effects. Can be used as a predicate with になる or が{続|つづ}く.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食欲不振|しょくよくふしん}になる (to lose one's appetite)
- {食欲不振|しょくよくふしん}が{続|つづ}く (loss of appetite continues)
- {食欲不振|しょくよくふしん}の{症状|しょうじょう} (symptoms of poor appetite)
- {食欲不振|しょくよくふしん}を{訴|うった}える (to report loss of appetite)

ETYMOLOGY:
{食欲|しょくよく} (appetite) + {不振|ふしん} (slump, poor performance).
